scripts.build: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:relayd && pnpm build:mcp && pnpm build:menubar
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @relay/web build && pnpm --filter @relay/menu-bar build:panel && rm -rf out/relayd && mkdir -p out/relayd && cp -R apps/web/out out/relayd/web && cp -R apps/menu-bar/out/panel out/relayd/panel
scripts.pack:mac: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @relay/menu-bar exec electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.pack:dir: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @relay/menu-bar exec electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.release:mac: pnpm build && RELAY_UPDATE_URL=$RELAY_UPDATE_URL pnpm --filter @relay/menu-bar exec electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish always
